<script>
(function () {
  var form = document.getElementById('cs-reg-form');
  var errorBox = document.getElementById('cs-error');
  var success = document.getElementById('cs-success');
  var button = document.getElementById('cs-submit');

  function showError(msg) { errorBox.textContent = msg; errorBox.classList.add('is-visible'); }
  function clearError() { errorBox.textContent = ''; errorBox.classList.remove('is-visible'); }

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearError();

    var email = form.email.value.trim();
    var role = form.querySelector('input[name="role"]:checked');
    var sessions = Array.prototype.map.call(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="session"]:checked'), function (el) { return el.value; });
    var consent = form.consent.checked;

    if (sessions.length === 0) { showError('Please tick at least one session.'); return; }
    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { showError('Please enter a valid email address.'); form.email.focus(); return; }
    if (!role) { showError('Please choose the option that best describes your work.'); return; }
    if (!consent) { showError('Please tick the box to agree to how we use your details.'); return; }

    var payload = {
      access_key: form.access_key.value,
      subject: 'ClimateSense session registration: ' + email,
      from_name: form.from_name.value,
      email: email,
      role: role.value,
      sessions: sessions.join('; '),
      consent: 'yes',
      botcheck: form.botcheck.checked ? 'on' : ''
    };

    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Sending…';

    fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (data) { return { ok: r.ok, data: data }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res.ok && res.data && res.data.success) {
          form.hidden = true;
          success.classList.add('is-visible');
          success.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        } else {
          throw new Error((res.data && res.data.message) || 'Submission failed');
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        showError('Something went wrong and your registration was not sent. Please try again, or email monika.maciuliene@ktu.lt with your preferred session.');
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = 'Register';
      });
  });
})();
</script>

Questions? Write to [monika.maciuliene@ktu.lt](mailto:monika.maciuliene@ktu.lt).

## What happens in a session

- We show you one of our tools, with a real example.
- We ask how you handle climate claims in your own work: where they come from, what you check, where you get stuck.
- You tell us what would help and what is missing.

## About ClimateSense

ClimateSense is a European research project. We build tools for people who work on climate misinformation: a database of fact-checks, a map of where claims appear, and a database of who lobbies against climate policy ([LACK](https://climatesense-project.eu/lack/)). We want these tools to fit how you work.
